a. Your US Privacy Rights 
Residents of some states have certain rights in relation to their personal information. We describe below the rights that may be available to you, depending on your state of residence.

Right to Request Access to Your Personal Information
You may have the right to request, up to two times in a 12-month period, access to the personal information we have collected about you and information regarding the source of that personal information, the purposes for which we collect it, and the third parties and service providers to whom we sell, share, or disclose it. Please note that certain information may be exempt from such requests under law.

Right to Request Correction of Your Personal Information
You may have the right to request that in certain circumstances we correct personal information that we have collected about you. Some information may be exempt from such requests under law.

Right to Request Deletion of Your Personal Information
You may also have the right to request that we delete personal information that we have collected from or about you. Some personal information may be exempt from such requests under law.  For example, we need certain types of personal information so that we can provide our Properties to you.  If you ask us to delete it, you may no longer be able to access or use our Properties.

Limit Use of Your Sensitive Personal Information
California residents have the right to limit our use of their sensitive personal information if we use such personal information to infer characteristics about them. We do not currently use sensitive personal information for such purposes. In some states, we may be required to obtain your consent before collecting your sensitive personal information.

Sale and Sharing of Personal Information; Targeted Advertising
Under the laws of some states, consumers have the right to opt out of the sale of personal information or the sharing of their personal information with third parties for targeted advertising (also known as cross-context behavioral advertising or interest-based advertising). In applicable states, Activision automatically opts out any users who it knows to be between the ages of 13 and 15 from receiving targeted advertising. 

We share certain information with third parties who do work on our behalf for the business purposes we describe above. 

We also may allow third-party advertising companies to collect Information about your activity on our websites and in our apps, for example through cookies, mobile ad identifiers, pixels, web beacons and social network plugins.  These advertising entities use Information they collect to help us provide more relevant advertisements and for other purposes described in our Privacy Policy.  You can control the sharing of your personal information for targeted advertising through our websites and apps in the following ways:

To set up cookie controls and opt-out of advertising cookies, including third-party advertising cookies,  by clicking the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer of our websites. 
You can also set up cookie controls through many browser settings and you can use industry-wide opt outs to control the use of cookies for interest-based advertising purposes.  
You may also opt out through the settings page of Activision mobile applications that may share your data for these purposes.  You can find additional information in the Mobile Advertising section above and in our Cookie Policy (https://www.activision.com/legal/cookie-policy). 

The personal information collected through these methods is associated with your browser or device, so if you would like to opt out for this information you will need to disable cookies or trackers as described above. Because your opt-out preference is stored in a cookie, if you reset your advertising ID or clear your cookies then we will not recognize your device or your choices, so you must opt out again. You may also disable non-advertising cookies through your browser or device settings.
In applicable states, where required, Activision recognizes Do Not Track settings and the Global Privacy Control.
Personal Information Collected Through Activision Accounts: In addition to the opt-outs related to advertising above, we support the applicable state laws by allowing residents to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information for targeted advertising by visiting our Privacy Portal (https://support.activision.com/privacy). Logging in with an account helps us to process your request. You can also submit a request to opt out of sales or sharing by emailing us at privacyrequests@activision.com. 
How to Exercise Your Access, Correction, and Deletion Rights
You may exercise any privacy rights to which you are entitled by submitting your request to us here (https://support.activision.com/privacy) or sending an email to privacyrequests@activision.com. To exercise your right to correction, please update your account information directly or send an email to privacyrequests@activision.com.

For security purposes, we will verify your identity – and may request information from you to do so – when you request to exercise your privacy rights. If you have an online account you use to interact with Activision, logging into your account will serve to verify your identity and request.  We may request additional information if we believe your account has been compromised. If you do not have an account with us, or if we have reason to suspect that the security of your account is compromised, then we may request additional information from you to match with our existing records to verify your identity, depending on the nature of the request and the sensitivity of the information sought.

Some states permit you to designate an agent to make requests to exercise your rights as described above. We will take steps to both verify the identity of the person seeking to exercise their rights as listed above, and to verify that your agent has been authorized to make a request on your behalf through providing us with a signed written authorization or a copy of a power of attorney.

Once we have verified your identity (and your authorized agent, as applicable), we will respond to your request as appropriate. If we are unable to complete your requests, we will provide you information about the reasons that we could not comply with your request, as required by applicable law.

Profiling
We do not engage in “profiling” in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

Right to Nondiscrimination
We will not deny, charge different prices for, or provide a different level of quality of goods or services if you choose to exercise these rights, unless allowed under applicable law. 

Appeals
Some state laws allow residents who are not satisfied with our response to their requests to appeal our decision by contacting us as described in the written notice we will provide to you.

b. Additional Privacy Information for California Residents

Notice of Privacy Practices for California Residents
Depending on how you interact with us, Activision may collect about you the following categories of personal information. For information about the purposes for which we use and disclose information, and additional potential disclosures of personal information, please see Users in the US section above.

Identifiers, collected from you, our social media pages, or third-party subscription service providers, may be disclosed to our service providers and may be sold to or shared with business partners.
Financial information, collected from you, may be disclosed to our service providers. We do not sell or share financial information. 
Protected classifications and other sensitive data, collected from you, may be disclosed to our service providers. We do not sell or share protected classifications and other sensitive data.
Commercial information, collected from you, may be shared with our service providers. We do not sell or share commercial information.
Geolocation information, collected from you and our analytics and advertising partners, may be shared with our service providers. We may sell or share coarse location information to our advertising partners; we do not sell or share precise geolocation information.
Internet or electronic network activity information, collected from you and our analytics and advertising partners, may be shared with our service providers, and may be sold to our advertising partners. 
Audio, electronic, visual, thermal, olfactory, or similar information, collected from you, may be shared with our service providers. We do not sell or share such information.
Inferences drawn about you, collected from you and our advertising and analytics partners, may be shared with our service providers. We may sell or share such information with our advertising partners. 
Content of communications, collected from you, may be shared with our service providers. We do not sell or share content of communications.
Information of contacts that you supply to us may be shared with our service providers. We do not sell or share such information.

We determine the retention period for each of the categories of personal information listed above based on (1) the length of time we need to retain the information to achieve the business or commercial purpose for which it was obtained, (2) any legal or regulatory requirements applicable to such information, (3) internal operational needs, and (4) any need for the information based on any actual or anticipated investigation or litigation. 

California residents have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information, as explained in the Sale and Sharing of Personal Information; Targeted Advertising section above. 

The reporting information required by the California Consumer Privacy Act Regulations § 999.317 is available here (https://www.activision.com/legal/ccpa-report).

We may need to collect your personal information in order to offer you the benefits and rewards you request.  For example, we may need your email address in order to verify your account to deliver an in-game item. If we do offer you the chance to participate in such a program, your participation is optional. If you choose to participate, your participation will be subject to the applicable terms or conditions, and you may withdraw at any time.  Your information has no real currency value or its equivalent.

California Shine the Light Law
Since 2005, California Civil Code Section 1798.83 permits our customers who are California residents to request certain information regarding our disclosure of personal information to third parties for their direct marketing purposes. We do not share our customer's personal information with third parties for their own direct marketing purposes, without their approval. For inquiries regarding our disclosure policy, please send us an email to privacy@activision.com, or write us at: Activision Publishing, Inc., 2701 Olympic Boulevard Building B, Santa Monica, CA 90404 USA, ATTN: Privacy Team/Privacy Policy. 
California Privacy Rights for Minor Users
Since January 1, 2015, California Business and Professions Code Section 22581 permits you, if you are a California resident under the age of 18, to view, correct, or remove Information provided by you or publicly posted by you, by accessing your Activision account through https://www.activision.com/ or another product or service as applicable and editing/removing your Information. You will need your password to access your personal account. You may also send us an email asking us to remove certain posted content at privacy@activision.com. In the alternative, you may write to us at Activision Publishing, Inc., 2701 Olympic Boulevard Building B, Santa Monica, CA 90404 USA, ATTN: Privacy Team/Privacy Policy.
We will be happy to review, update or remove Information and/or content as appropriate. Residual copies of Information and/or content that have been removed from your account and/or the Properties may remain in our backup systems for approximately one month. We may still retain your Information to resolve disputes, enforce our user agreement, or comply with legal requirements; in this case, your personal information will be blocked from use for any other purpose.
c. Privacy Information for Nevada Residents

Under Nevada law, Nevada residents who have purchased goods or services from us may opt out of the “sale” of “covered information” (as such terms are defined under Nevada law) for monetary consideration to a person for that person to license or sell such information to additional persons.  “Covered information” includes first and last name, address, email address, and phone number, or an identifier that allows a specific person to be contacted either physically or online.  As discussed above, we share your information with certain third parties that we believe can provide you with offers and promotions for products and service of interest to you and in the other ways described above.  We do not believe that our sharing in this regard would qualify as a sale under Nevada law. Nonetheless, if you are a Nevada resident who has purchased goods or services from us, you may submit a request to record your preference to opt out by emailing us at individualrights@activision.com.   Please note we may take reasonable steps to verify your identity and the authenticity of the request.

to debug and improve our current and future Properties;
in order to give you exclusive content, personalize your online experience with us and contact you in accordance with applicable marketing preferences;

You can bring the complaint in your member state of residence, place of work or where an alleged infringement of data protection law occurred.

International Transfers

codcaster/3rd_person_camera_follow_mode_:
^$Fixed^7: The camera remains behind the spectated player's operator.

^$Orbital^7: The camera is tethered at a specific distance from the operator and the Codcaster is able to move the camera around them.
codcaster/aerial_camera_default_desc:
Sets the Aerial Camera's mode on used on map start.

^$Follow^7: The camera is tethered to the spectated player and the observer can offset the camera position around this player.

^$Free^7: The observer fully controls the Aerial Camera's position.
codcaster/aerial_camera_movement_smoothi:
^$Low Value^7: Aerial Camera movement is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^$High Value^7: Aerial Camera movement is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.
codcaster/aerial_camera_movement_speed_d: Adjust the speed of the Aerial Camera's movement.
codcaster/aerial_camera_pucks_enabled_de:
Display an arrow VFX under players while using the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

Pucks are visible through walls and increase visibility while spectating.
codcaster/aerial_camera_rotation_speed_d: Adjust the speed at which the Aerial Camera rotates 90 degrees.
codcaster/aerial_camera_transition_time_: Sets the amount of time required to switch to the Aerial Camera.
codcaster/aerial_camera_vertical_movemen:
^$Low Value^7: Aerial Camera zoom is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^$High Value^7: Aerial Camera zoom is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.
Adjust the speed of the Aerial Camera's zoom.
codcaster/announcements_desc:

codcaster/bindings_aerialcam_desc:

Press to show a fullscreen overlay displaying detailed player statistics.
Press again to hide it.

This view can only be displayed in supported 4v4 game modes.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Scoreboard"^7 in the Interface Keybinds sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_decrease_fov_desc: Press and hold to decrease the Field of View (FOV) while using the Free Camera.
codcaster/bindings_fieldupgradeview_desc:
Press to show each player's Field Upgrade and their charge percentage.
Press again to hide them.
codcaster/bindings_fly_down_zoom_in_desc:
Press and hold to zoom in while using the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Fly Down" (Free Camera)^7.
codcaster/bindings_fly_up_zoom_out_desc:
Press and hold to zoom out while using the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Fly Up" (Free Camera)^7.
codcaster/bindings_flydown_desc: Press and hold to fly down while using the ^$Free Camera^7.
codcaster/bindings_flyup_desc: Press and hold to fly up while using the ^$Free Camera^7.
codcaster/bindings_freecam_desc:
Press to switch to a player controlled camera.
Press again to switch back to the first person spectating view.

This camera allows Codcasters to fly around the map to spectate the match.
codcaster/bindings_freecam_presets_modif:
Hold this key and the Set Camera Preset key and then press one of the ^$Camera Preset^7 keys to save a camera preset to the corresponding slot +10.

Once a camera preset is saved, hold this keybind and press the desired slot's key to move the game's camera to this exact position and rotation in ^$Free Camera^7 view.
codcaster/bindings_fullscreenmap_desc:
Press to show a fullscreen overlay of the current map's outline.
Press again to hide it.
codcaster/bindings_hidelayer_desc:
Press to hide ^$all Codcaster HUD elements^7 at once.
Press again to show them.
codcaster/bindings_increase_fov_desc: Press and hold to increase the Field of View (FOV) while using the Free Camera.
codcaster/bindings_killstreakview_desc:
Press to show each player's Killstreaks.
Press again to hide them.
codcaster/bindings_minimap_desc:
Press to hide the current map's outline overlay.
Press again to show it.
codcaster/bindings_move_back_desc:
Press and hold to move backward while using the ^$Free Camera^7 or the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Move Backward"^7 in the Movement sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_move_forward_desc:
Press and hold to move forward while using the ^$Free Camera^7 or the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Move Forward"^7 in the Movement sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_move_left_desc:
Press and hold to move left while using the ^$Free Camera^7 or the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Move Left"^7 in the Movement sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_move_right_desc:
Press and hold to move right while using the ^$Free Camera^7 or the ^$Aerial Camera^7.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Move Right"^7 in the Movement sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_movement_mode_desc: Press to switch between ^$Free^7 and ^$Horizontal^7 movement modes for the ^$Free Camera^7.
codcaster/bindings_orbital_mode_desc:
Press to switch between the 3rd Person Camera's ^$Fixed^7 and ^$Orbital^7 modes.

By default, ^$this keybind is linked with "Follow Mode" (Aerial Camera)^7.
codcaster/bindings_pause_game_desc:
Hold the ^$Set Camera Preset^7 key and then press the ^$CDL Timeout^7 key to call a timeout for the current match for the host and all clients.
Reuse this key combination to resume the match or cancel an upcoming timeout.
codcaster/bindings_reset_fov_desc: Press to reset the Field of View (FOV) while using the Free Camera.
codcaster/bindings_rotate_clockwise_desc: Press to rotate the ^$Aerial Camera^7 orientation by 90 degrees clockwise.
codcaster/bindings_rotate_counterclockwi: Press to rotate the ^$Aerial Camera^7 orientation by 90 degrees counterclockwise.
codcaster/bindings_selectnext_desc: Press to move the ^$Player Selector^7 on the next slot of the ^$Team List^7.
codcaster/bindings_selectprevious_desc: Press to move the ^$Player Selector^7 on the previous slot of the ^$Team List^7.
codcaster/bindings_selectspectate_desc: Press to spectate the player being highlighted by the ^$Player Selector^7 on the ^$Team List^7.
codcaster/bindings_set_camera_preset_des:
Hold this key and press one of the ^$Camera Preset^7 keys to save a camera preset to the corresponding slot.

Once a camera preset is saved, press that slot's key to move the game's camera to this exact position and rotation in ^$Free Camera^7 view.
codcaster/bindings_settingsmenu_desc: Open the ^$Settings Menu^7 directly on the CoDCaster tab.
codcaster/bindings_slow_down_desc:
Press and hold to temporarily use a slower movement speed for the ^$Free Camera^7.
Stop holding to revert to the normal Free Camera movement speed.

You can tweak this speed using the ^$Low Speed Modifier^7 setting of the Free Camera in the ^$Cameras^7 sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_spectate1_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 1^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate2_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 2^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate3_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 3^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate4_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 4^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate5_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 5^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate6_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 6^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate7_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 7^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectate8_desc: Press to spectate the player in ^$Slot 8^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectatenext_desc: Press to spectate the next player on the ^$Team List^7.
codcaster/bindings_spectateprevious_desc: Press to spectate the previous player on the ^$Team List^7.
codcaster/bindings_speed_up_desc:
Press and hold to temporarily use a faster movement speed for the ^$Free Camera^7.
Stop holding to revert to the normal Free Camera movement speed.

You can tweak this speed using the ^$High Speed Modifier^7 setting of the Free Camera in the ^$Cameras^7 sub-category.
codcaster/bindings_teamlistype_desc:
Press to switch between displaying the Portrait List or the Player List in the ^$Team List^7.

The ^$Portrait List^7 displays operator portraits.
The ^$Player List^7 displays brief player stats.

The ^$Portrait List^7 can only be displayed when there are 4 players or less per team.
codcaster/bindings_thirdperson_desc:
Press to switch to an over-the-shoulder point of view.
Press again to switch back to the first person spectating view.
codcaster/bindings_toggle_collisions_des:
Press to toggle collisions in ^$Free Camera^7.
Press again to turn them off.
codcaster/bindings_xray_desc:
Press to hide colored outlines on players and objectives.
Press again to show them.

Players, Loadout Elements and Objectives X-Ray settings can be set under the ^$X-Ray^7 setting of the ^$Visual^7 category.
codcaster/camera_smoothing_desc:
Enable or disable camera movement smoothing on the Free Camera and the Aerial Camera.

Camera Smoothing averages the movement of the camera based on the last two frames' average, resulting in a smoother but less precise camera movement.
codcaster/codcaster_button_disabled: Codcaster is not supported for this mode.
codcaster/countdown_series_text_desc: Displays the series text during the match countdown.
codcaster/datacenter_desc: Set the ^5datacenter^7 to be used for games on a ^5custom dedicated server^7.
codcaster/decreasefov_desc: Press and hold to ^$decrease^7 the Field of View (FOV) while using the ^$Free Camera^7.
codcaster/display_settings_desc: Control which Display Settings are enabled by default when Codcasting.
codcaster/field_upgrade_desc: Display a notification over a player's Portrait List slot when they activate a Field Upgrade.
codcaster/first_person_xray_desc:
Display or hide ^$XRAY^7 outlines on a player's weapon in First Person view for a few seconds when switching players.

This setting is independent from the other XRAY settings.
codcaster/free_camera_clipping_enabled_d: Enable collisions for the free Camera
codcaster/free_camera_field_of_view_desc:
Set the Free Camera's default ^$Field of View^7.

This setting exclusively affects the Free Camera's Field of View for Codcaster.
codcaster/free_camera_high_factor_desc: Adjust the value of the Free Camera's high speed modifier.
codcaster/free_camera_input_type_desc:
^$Hold^7: Press and Hold to apply a Free Camera speed modifier. Release to return to the base movement speed.

^$Toggle^7: Press to apply a Free Camera speed modifier. Press again to return to the base movement speed.
codcaster/free_camera_movement_mode_desc:
^$Free^7: Moves the Free Camera in the direction it is currently facing.

^$Horizontal^7: Movement is locked vertically, allowing observers to focus camera angles while keeping the same altitude more easily.
codcaster/free_camera_pucks_enabled_desc:
Display an arrow VFX under players while using the ^$Free Camera^7.

Pucks are visible through walls and increase visibility while spectating.
codcaster/free_camera_slow_factor_desc: Adjust the value of the Free Camera's low speed modifier.
codcaster/free_camera_smoothing_desc:
^$Low Value^7: Free Camera movement is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^$High Value^7: Free Camera movement is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.
codcaster/free_camera_speed_desc: Adjust the basic movement speed for the ^$Free Camera^7.
codcaster/free_camera_vertical_smoothing:
^$Low Value^7: Free Camera Fly Up and Fly Down movement is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^$High Value^7: Free Camera Fly Up and Fly Down movement is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.
codcaster/free_camera_vertical_speed_des: Adjust the speed of the ^$Free Camera^7's fly up and fly down movements.
codcaster/freecam_rotation_smoothing_des:
^$Low value^7: Free Camera rotation is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^$High value^7: Free Camera rotation is sharper and reflects the observer's rotation inputs more closely.
codcaster/increasefov_desc: Press and hold to ^$increase^7 the Field of View (FOV) while using the ^$Free Camera^7.
codcaster/killfeed_desc: Displays the killer, victim, and weapon used for each kill.
codcaster/killstreaks_notifications_desc: Display notifications over a player's Portrait List slot when they earn Killstreaks or when they activate them.
codcaster/minimap_desc: Displays an overview of the current map with players and objective positions represented by arrows and icons.
codcaster/movement_mode_desc:
^$Free^7: Moves the Free Camera in the direction it is currently facing.

^$Horizontal^7: Movement is locked vertically, allowing observers to focus camera angles while keeping the same altitude more easily.
codcaster/orbital_camera_rotation_smooth:
^$Low Value^7: Orbital 3rd Person Camera rotation is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^$High Value^7: Orbital 3rd Person Camera is sharper and reflects the observer's rotation inputs more closely.
codcaster/player_card_desc: Displays detailed information about the spectated player, including the player's name, portrait, statistics, and equipment.
codcaster/player_card_equipment_desc:
Displays the spectated player's equipment tiles in the ^$Player Card^7.

This includes lethals, tacticals, and Field Upgrades.
codcaster/player_card_killstreaks_desc: Displays the spectated player's Killstreaks in the ^$Player Card^7.
codcaster/player_card_portrait_desc: Displays the spectated player's operator portrait in the ^$Player Card^7.
codcaster/player_card_weapon_info_desc: Displays the spectated player's current weapon and ammo count in the ^$Player Card^7.
codcaster/player_list_desc:
Select between Portrait List and Player List to be displayed in the ^$Team List^7.

^$Portrait List^7: Character portraits are displayed. Each player's current health is represented by their slot's background. Objective status is represented by an icon.

^$Player List^7: Player names and statistics are displayed. Objective status and death are represented by an icon.
codcaster/player_numbers_desc: Display Player Numbers on various parts of the Codcaster interface.
codcaster/player_numbers_player_card_des: Display Player Numbers on the ^$Player Card^7.
codcaster/player_numbers_team_list_desc: Display Player Numbers on the ^$Team List^7.
codcaster/player_numbers_type_desc: Display either ^$Default Player Numbers^7 or replace them with ^$Jersey Player Numbers^7.
codcaster/player_order_desc: Manage the player order which will be used when Codcasting.
codcaster/player_scoring_desc: Display points a player earns for kills, assists, objectives, and more next to the crosshair.
codcaster/playernameplates_desc: Display information about each player over their in-game operator, including names, and players numbers.
codcaster/primary_color_details:
Primary colors are the main colors used to identify teams on various Codcaster elements.

Includes:
• Team Header
• Spectated Player Portrait Background
• X-Rays
• Announcements
• Minimap Arrows
• Objective Waypoints
codcaster/quick_settings_desc: Control which Quick Settings are enabled by default when Codcasting.
codcaster/reorder_lobby_tool_tip: Automatically reorder lobby from order specified in broadcast files
codcaster/score_header_desc: Display a board hosting each team's current score, the game clock, the objective timer, and announcements.
codcaster/secondary_color_details:
Secondary colors are used to complement the Primary colors on specific elements.

Includes:
• Team Names
• Spectated Player Name Background in the Portrait List
• Name background in the Player Card
codcaster/series_score_bestof_limit_desc: Set the maximum amount of maps that can be played in a series.
codcaster/series_score_desc:
Display each team's map wins in a series.

The ^$Best of Limit^7 and ^$Team Override^7 settings can be used to set maximum series length and individual teams map wins.
codcaster/specialist_notifications_desc: Display or hide ^$Specialist Perks Notifications^7 that appear over the ^$Portrait List^7 when a player earns them.
codcaster/starting_camera_desc: Choose to start the match using the 1st Person Camera, Free Camera, Aerial Camera, or 3rd Person Camera.
codcaster/status_effect_indicators_desc: Display icons when the spectated player is stunned, flashed, or burning.
codcaster/substitute_color_details:
Substitute colors override the primary color on specific elements to ensure legibility.

Includes:
• Nameplates
• X-Rays
• Killfeed
• Objective Waypoints
codcaster/swap_teams_desc: Swap the name, icon and color of both teams.
codcaster/team1_series_score_override_de: Set the number of maps won for ^$Team 1^7.
codcaster/team1_settings_desc: Modify the name, icon and color for Team 1.
codcaster/team2_series_score_override_de: Set the number of maps won for ^$Team 2^7.
codcaster/team2_settings_desc: Modify the name, icon and color for Team 2.
codcaster/team_identity_desc:
Select appearance settings for each team when watching a match as a Codcaster.
Team Names, Logos, and Colors can be changed in this menu.

^$These settings are not available during a match.^7
codcaster/team_list_desc:
Display information about players on each team through either the Portrait List or Player List.

Displaying the Portrait List or the Player List can be selected using the ^$Team List Type^7 setting.
codcaster/team_settings_tips_desc:
- Team names allow up to 30 characters in length.

- Primary colors are the main colors used to identify teams on various CoDCaster elements. This includes the Portrait List, Player Card, Score Header, XRAYS, Announcements, Minimap arrows and more.

- Secondary colors are used on detailing elements including Player Names the Team List and the Player Card, on Announcements and Objective Waypoints letters.

- Pick primary and secondary colors that have good contrast between them.

- Avoid color combinations that are unfriendly for colorblind viewers such as using red and green.
codcaster/ticker_space_desc: Raise the position of the Player Card, Minimap, and Killfeed in the Codcaster interface.
codcaster/time_to_beat_ctf_ended_game: &&1 WAS FASTEST TO CAPTURE THE FLAG
codcaster/timeout_requested_round_desc: Timeout is set to occur on next round.
codcaster/top_elements_offset_desc: Lower the position of the Team List and Score Header in the Codcaster interface.
codcaster/waypoint_markers_desc: Display indicators to identify objective locations.
codcaster/xray_advanced_targets_desc: Select if X-Rays are displayed on players, objectives, or both.
codcaster/xray_desc: Displays outlines that can be seen through walls on various game elements.
codcaster/xray_loadout_elements_desc:
Select if X-Rays are displayed or not on loadout elements including equipment, Killstreaks and Field Upgrades.

^$This setting only affects the loadout elements of players who have X-Rays.^7
codcaster/xray_objectives_desc: Select if X-Rays are displayed or not on objectives.
codcaster/xray_players_desc: Select if X-Rays are displayed or not on players.
codcaster/xray_type_desc: Select if X-Rays are displayed on allies, enemies, or both.

platform/auto_forward_enabled_gamepad_de:
^$Off:^7 Pushing the movement stick (left by default) forward will not make you continuously move forward.

^$Single Tap:^7 Pushing the stick forward ^$once^7 will make you continuously move forward. Pull it backwards to stop. Sprinting does not interrupt auto move forward.

^$Double Tap:^7 Pushing the stick forward ^$twice^7 rapidly will make you continuously move forward. Pull it backwards to stop. Sprinting does not interrupt auto move forward.
platform/automatic_sprint_gamepad_desc:
^$^BOff:^R^7 Sprint is activated manually with the Sprint button.

^$^BAutomatic Sprint:^R^7 Move Forward while standing to automatically sprint. Press the Sprint button twice in quick succession while sprinting to activate Tactical Sprint.

^$^BAutomatic Tactical Sprint:^R^7 Move Forward while standing to automatically activate Tactical Sprint.

Automatic Sprint will not change your current stance (e.g.: crouched, prone) and will not cancel other actions in progress (e.g.: reloading, aiming down sights).
platform/automatic_sprint_kbm_desc:
^$^BOff:^R^7 Sprint is activated manually with any Sprint ([{kbm:breath_sprint}]) keybind.

^$^BAutomatic Sprint:^R^7 Press ^$Move Forward^7 ([{kbm:+forward}]) while standing to automatically sprint. Press any Sprint or Tactical Sprint ([{kbm:breath_sprint}]) keybind while sprinting to activate the Tactical Sprint.

^$^BAutomatic Tactical Sprint:^R^7 Press ^$Move Forward^7 ([{kbm:+forward}]) while standing to automatically activate Tactical Sprint.

Automatic Sprint will not change your current stance (e.g.: crouched, prone) and will not cancel other actions in progress (e.g.: reloading, aiming down sights). Walking ([{kbm:+walk}]) has priority over Automatic Sprint.

platform/dyk_iw5_msg14: Earn Care Package airdrops by completing Field Orders. Care Packages award a random killstreak.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg15: In Infected mode, use Tactical Insertions as an Infected to mark where your next respawn will be.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg16: You can Neutralize an enemy controlled flag in Domination by reaching the halfway mark when capturing it.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg17: Complete Operations to earn bonus Patches, XP, Squad Points, and Character Customization gear.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg18: In Blitz, enter the enemy objective zone while it is active to score for your team.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg19: In Blitz, the enemy objective zone has a cool down period after each score; don't stay out in the open.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg2: Get Assault and Specialist Killstreak Rewards by getting consecutive kills without dying.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg20: The Muzzle Brake attachment increases your weapon's maximum effective range.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg21: The Off the Grid Perk makes you invisible to SAT COMs and radar pings.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg22: The Takedown Perk lets you kill enemies without revealing their death locations to their teammates.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg23: Bridge the gap between infantry and sniper with a Marksman Rifle.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg24: Contextual Lean can be disabled in the Settings Menu if you prefer a more classic style of play.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg26: Holding crouch while sprinting initiates a tactical slide to help you get to cover.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg27: Fully charge a 9-Bang to create an EMP effect that temporarily disables Sentry Guns and other automated equipment.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg28: Want more control of your killstreak helicopter? Hop into the cockpit of an AAS-72X as a Helo Pilot.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg29: Use the Incog perk to stay hidden from enemy targeting, Thermal and Tracker sights, and Motion Sensors.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg3: Cranked is a fast-paced game mode where chaining kills gives you speed perks, 2x scoring, and keeps you alive.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg30: Some maps have special killstreak rewards when calling in Field Order Care Packages.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg31: In Search and Rescue, recover Dog Tags to respawn friendlies and deny enemy respawns.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg32: Check out the Squads playlists to see how your custom Squad stacks up against the competition.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg33: Assault and Marksman Rifle select fire types can be adjusted in the attachments menu.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg34: Provide tactical support from the sky with the Helo Scout killstreak.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg35: The Tracker Sight outlines enemy targets and can be flipped down on the fly for a wider field of view.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg36: The Honey Badger, VKS and K7 have integrated silencer attachments.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg37: The Night Owl drone follows you, detects enemies in close proximity and actively destroys incoming explosives.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg38: Killstreak Rewards attained from airdrop crates do not count towards your killstreak count.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg39: Akimbo weapons give you more firepower but restrict your ability to Aim Down Sight.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg4: Some killstreak rewards are controllable but leave you vulnerable on the ground.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg40: Combat Exclusion Rules lifted! Customize the look and gender of your Squad Member.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg41: Customize each Squad Member with its own Strike Package to be ready for any situation that might be thrown at you.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg42: Assault Strike Package items will chain kills to earn the next one.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg43: The Flash Suppressor attachment reduces muzzle flash for better accuracy, while maintaining full weapon damage.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg44: Armor Piercing rounds can penetrate Ballistic Vests, Juggernaut Armor and deal extra damage to killstreaks.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg45: The Wiretap Perk gives you access to active enemy SAT COMs on the field and stacks with your team's SAT COMs as well.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg46: Check out the Squads playlists to see how your custom Squad stacks up against the competition.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg47: The Specialist Strike Package lets you earn additional Perks as you kill, with a larger bonus at the end of your chain.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg48: Strike Packages give you the choice of supporting your team, being on the offensive, or being more of a lone gun.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg49: The Blind Eye Perk makes you undetectable by AI targeting systems of all kinds including air support and sentries.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg5: Track your Leaderboard position in the Barracks.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg50: The Vulture drone is a flying sentry gun that covers your six.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg51: The Trinity Rocket lets you control a missile from above that can fire off additional smart drone projectiles.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg52: The Support Strike Package doesn't reset your killstreak kills when you die.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg53: In a match, you have three killstreak slots with one extra slot to store any killstreaks you get by other means.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg54: Your extra killstreak slot stacks, so you don't need to worry about losing earned killstreaks when changing loadouts.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg55: Scroll up and down through your killstreaks and use the one that you want right now.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg6: One SAT COM activates 'Eyes On', marking enemies you see to the minimap. Place more SAT COMs to get a full radar sweep.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg7: Swap out Frag Grenades for Throwing Knives, Canister Bombs and other Lethal equipment.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg8: Your Guard Dog is your best friend. The dog alerts you to nearby enemies, protects you, and avenges your death.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg9: Aiming Down Sights near the edge of an object, vehicle or building activates Contextual Lean.
