weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_10_flavor: Who needs nightvision when you have the Dusk Ripper Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_11_flavor: Maul your enemies with the Black Bear Assault Rifle, featuring the built-in ^1Dismemberment^7 effect to amp up the destruction.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_12_flavor: Liberate 'em with The Noble Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_13_flavor: You're already a winner—the Upper Hand Assault Rifle reinforces your success with its rugged good looks.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_15_flavor: Keep your eyes on the prize with the Trophy Mount Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_1_flavor: Farah Karim’s own assault rifle “Revolution” is a simple affair, whose Muzzle Brake, Skeleton Stock, and Mo’ Money Perk are all there in the interest of getting the job done.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_2_flavor: Kick up a real stink with the Pink Perforator assault rifle - it'll help you really tear your enemies a new one with its Monocle Reflex Sight, 8.1" Compact Barrel, 5.45x39mm 30-Round Mags, and No Stock.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_4_flavor: The Wendigo is a man-eating spirit. This aptly-named assault rifle shares the same sentiment and harnesses the Corp Combat Holo Sight, Spetsnaz Elite barrel, Field LMG Stock, and Operator Foregrip to get the job done...or the men eaten, as the case may be.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_5_flavor: We all know that one man’s terrorist is another’s Freedom Fighter but this assault rifle, with its 8.1" Compact Barrel, Viper Reflex Sight, Tac Laser, and 30-Round Mags, does not discriminate in striking terror into the hearts of all fighters who face off against it.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_6_flavor: Get Beastly with the RPK Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_7_flavor: Bury your opponents in unmarked graves with the Sand Sweeper Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_8_flavor: They’ll be seeing red when you deploy with the Duly Devoted Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_akilo47_9_flavor: The breath of the Golden Dragon assault rifle is delivered in a variety of flavors: high-explosive, good old-fashioned lead, and even cold steel. It comes with a bayonet, GP25 40mm high-explosive, 75-round drum mags, and a Field LMG Stock.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_10_flavor: Prowl the battlefield with the Devourer Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_11_flavor: Be a 'frags to riches' story with the Deep Pockets Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_14_flavor: Fade them to black with the Half Dying Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_2_flavor: The Liar is an assault rifle with a sniper scope, Colossus suppressor and FORGE TAC ballast pack. At least, that’s what it wants you to believe.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_3_flavor: Inconspicuous it isn’t, although the bright pink camouflage of the Dream Killer serves one purpose very well indeed: its bold look will lull your enemies into a false sense of security – the Flash Guard, 25 Round Mags, Ranger Foregrip, and a Fully Loaded Perk will crush any ideas they may have harbored about an easy ride.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_4_flavor: Spitting fire is the least of the tasks the Bronze Dragon Assault Rifle excels at. The VLK 3.0x Optic, Compensator, Merc Foregrip, Oden Ultralight Hollow stock, and Frangible - Disabling Perk, allow it to be extremely usable and accurate too.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_6_flavor: Dispatch your enemies with extreme venom—the Black ASP Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_7_flavor: A single bite from this Assault Rifle can be catastrophic. Featuring an integral hybrid optic, M203 40mm High-Explosive, Rubberized Grip tape, Oden Ultralight Hollow stock, and a Tac Laser.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_8_flavor: You're the aftershock. They're the afterthought. This is the Ground Splitter Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_asierra12_9_flavor: If you're going to punish the naughty, this AR, Krampus, seems like a good way to go. Solozero Optics' mini reflex, tactical suppressor, Oden factory 420mm barrel, operator foregrip, and a stippled grip tape round out the accessories.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_10_flavor: Caustic to the plan with the Acid Spit Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_2_flavor: Emerge from the undergrowth and take down enemies left and right with the Forest Shadows semi-automatic assault rifle. A Variable Zoom Scope, Tactical Suppressor, and integrated Bipod allow you to survive long enough to make tracks again once the deed is done.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_3_flavor: The Aristocrat is a thoroughbred semi-automatic assault rifle whose lineage was never in question due to it being furnished with a superlative roster of equipment: the Scout Combat Optic, an integrated Bipod, 30-Round Mags, and the Mo' Money Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_4_flavor: The Retro Grade gets top marks as a semi-automatic assault rifle since it comes equipped with a Solozero NVG Enhanced scope, an XRK Marksman barrel, FORGE TAC Stalker stock attachment and the Fast Melee Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_5_flavor: Stormcloud is a semi-automatic assault rifle whose VLK 3.0x Optic, Muzzle Brake, XRK Marksman barrel, and Tac Laser will allow you to weather a torrent of incoming fire and return it with gusto.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_6_flavor: A Viper reflex sight, 13" OSW Para barrel, tactical foregrip, Forge Tac Stalker and the Burst Perk make this assault rifle a perfect choice for khonducting Khemical warfare.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_7_flavor: The name says it all—aim for the head with this AR, featuring a Thermal Hybrid scope, Muzzle Brake, 13" OSW Para, Operator Foregrip, and Factory 18" Aluminum Stock.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_8_flavor: Stand your guard with the Beefeater Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_falima_9_flavor: Keep your enemies in sight with the Refractor Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_falpha_2_flavor: The Desert Rat burst-fire assault rifle has proven its worth in deserts, jungles and slums the world over with its 4.0x Flip Hybrid optic, FR 24.4” Sniper barrel, Merc Foregrip, and a Recon Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_falpha_3_flavor: You'll break more than troop formations and enemy lines with the Fractured Forces burst fire assault rifle - the Aim-Op Reflex sight, FR 15.9" Commando barrel, Commando Foregrip, and Sleight of Hand Perk will let you break through to the top of the scoreboard too.
weapon_flavor/ar_falpha_4_flavor: Take the steam out of their sails with the Bubble Burster burst-fire assault rifle, complete with Corp Combat Holo Sight, FR 24.4” Sniper barrel, FORGE TAC Ballast Pack, and a powerful 5mW Laser.
weapon_flavor/ar_falpha_5_flavor: It may be composed of lots of different pieces, but the Patchwork assault rifle, with a Sniper Scope, Compensator, FR 24.4" Sniper barrel, Bipod, and FORGE TAC Ballast Pack, will leave no doubt as to whether or not it is the complete package.
weapon_flavor/ar_falpha_7_flavor: Hone your craft with The Artisan Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_falpha_9_flavor: Let them hear you coming with the Jerboa Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_10_flavor: Have your enemies take a hike with the Fieldguide Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_11_flavor: The Grand Marshal Assault Rifle can trace its lineage all the way back to the Old West.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_12_flavor: For those who don't want to take a rolled-up newspaper into battle, it's the Web Weaver Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_13_flavor: It's a lot of coiled up furry to carry around: The Striking Tiger Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_14_flavor: Scare the life out of them with the Ghostly Premonitions Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_15_flavor: The last thing they'll see? Your Dying Light Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_16_flavor: Big bite. Little body. This is the Grub Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_2_flavor: The Regal Retribution is an assault rifle with a presence; indeed, it is a rifle whose aesthetics are matched by its utility, thanks to the Integral Hybrid optic, Singuard Arms 19.8" Prowler barrel, Ranger Foregrip, and 100-Round Drums.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_4_flavor: The Brass Tacks assault rifle has been created in an effort to get back to basics, and the VLK 3.0x Optic, Flash Guard, Tactical Foregrip, and FSS Close Quarters Stock, are as reliable as they come.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_5_flavor: While the name is only mildly amusing, this assault rifle configuration does however feature hilarious amounts of power and control with its compensator, Singuard Arms 19.8" prowler barrel, and tactical foregrip.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_7_flavor: Get hunting - the Ursa Major has maximum range for an assault rifle due to its Variable Zoom, Muzzle Brake, Operator Foregrip, Singuard Arms Sniper Pro, and a Singuard Arms 16.6" SOCOM Barrel.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_8_flavor: Canted scope, blue tracers, and an ADS-activated laser. What’s not to love on this boss assault rifle? Featuring a Canted Hybrid optic, Singuard Arms Sniper Pro, Commando Foregrip, 60 Round Mags, and a (blue) Tac Laser.
weapon_flavor/ar_kilo433_9_flavor: This isn't your first rodeo. The Battle Tested Assault Rifle has been around the block a few times too.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_10_flavor: Great for underground fights: unleash the Cagefighter Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_11_flavor: It's no illusion. It's the Forgotten Oasis Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_13_flavor: Death from above. And behind. This is the Sheet Lightning Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_1_flavor: They say good things come in small packages and the Short Stuff assault rifle is no exception with its Tempus Mini barrel, M13 skeleton stock and Mo' Money Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_2_flavor: You can blast more than sand with this assault rifle. Mud, dirt, water, concrete, wood... even people. The Sandblaster incorporates a Sniper Scope, Tempus Marksman barrel, Tactical Suppressor, and Bipod into its mission to destroy all the small, annoying, grainy stuff you might come up against.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_3_flavor: The meanness of this assault rifle shouldn't be underestimated - just like its namesake, it will continue to kill long after you are dead and buried. Features: Solozero Optics Mini Reflex, Tempus Mini, Ranger Foregrip, No Stock, and a Tac Laser.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_4_flavor: Cure your local lycanthropy problems with this effective assault rifle, the Silver Bullet. Those lupine abominations don’t stand a chance due to judicious use of 4.0x Flip Hybrid scope, FORGE TAC Stalker stock, bipod and Recon Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_5_flavor: They broke the mold when they made the Die Cast Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_6_flavor: The Brave is an assault rifle to promote liberty and unleash a boatload of pain on those who do not support the Land of the Free. These patriotic acts rely on the use of a Compensator, the Tempus Marksman barrel, 12-Gauge Deputy Underbarrel shotgun, Stippled Grip Tape, and 60 Round Mags. Note: bald eagle not included.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_7_flavor: The Cold Forge assault rifle is a sleek, stealthy, well-honed killing machine. The Cronen LP945 Mini Reflex, Tempus Cyclone, .300 Blackout 30-Round Mags, and an FSS Close Quarters Stock make it the ultimate stealth loadout.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_8_flavor: There's no treading lightly with the Tank Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mcharlie_9_flavor: Celebrate your long reign at the top with the Jubilee Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mgolf36_1_flavor: This versatile fully automatic 5.56mm light machine gun developed by FORGE TAC is ideal for the gunsmith enthusiast. The Holger's modular design is configurable for a broad range of engagements, making this weapon viable for whatever operation that comes your way.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_11_flavor: Great in corners, and great everywhere else. This is the Jumping Spider Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_12_flavor: Give them more than a penny for your thoughts with the Florin Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_13_flavor: Put them to sleep with the White Noise Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_14_flavor: Here are 141 reasons to eliminate your targets successfully with the Task Force Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_15_flavor: Regal, meet lethal. This is the Kingly Splendor Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_16_flavor: Follow your own rules with the Nonconformist Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_18_flavor: Send them to the afterlife with the Soulful Wanderer Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_1_flavor: The Zip Tie Assault Rifle will prove even more useful than penetrating oil and duct tape, since it's paired with these great attachments: Corp Combat Holo Sight, FSS 14.5" Tac Lite barrel, Singuard Arms Invader stock, and Tactical Foregrip.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_2_flavor: No-frills fully automatic assault rifle from FORGE TAC is kitted out for rapid target acquisition and heavy firepower. For the no-nonsense soldier who’s ready to lay down lead on the move.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_3_bullet_2: FORGE TAC CQS Close Quarters Stock
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_3_flavor: This no-frills fully automatic assault rifle from FORGE TAC is kitted out for rapid target acquisition and heavy sustained fire.  For the no-nonsense soldier who's ready to lay down lead on the move.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_4_flavor: Calibrutal is a mean, powerhouse assault rifle that throws its weight around using these heavy-duty attachments: Corp Combat Holo Sight, FSS 14.5" Tac Lite barrel, FORGE TAC CQS stock and .458 SOCOM 10-Round Mags.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_7_flavor: Oscar Mike is military speak for 'on the move' and you'll certainly be able to conduct your business as you go with this assault rifle which features an Aim-Op Reflex Sight, an FSS 11.5" Commando barrel, the Operator Foregrip, conversion to 9mm Para 32-Round Mags, and the Singuard Arms Invader Stock.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_8_flavor: Put the Polytope under a microscope and you will see that this assault rifle features a Variable Zoom Scope, Corvus Custom Marksman long barrel, 12-Gauge Deputy (underbarrel shotgun), .458 SOCOM 10-Round Mags, and the Frangible - Wounding Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_mike4_9_flavor: There will be no love lost when you break out The Breakup Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_10_flavor: Reach out and grab your targets with the Talon assault rifle; a Variable Zoom, FORGE TAC CQC Pro, Grenade Launcher, Stippled Grip Tape, and a FTAC Collapsible Stock all conspire to help you draw blood.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_11_flavor: Better dead than red? With the Cerise assault rifle you can have both. Featuring Canted Hybrid Optics, Compensator, Forge Tac CQC Pro, 25 Round Mags, and a Tac Laser.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_12_flavor: Pimp out your loadout with the Mack Daddy Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_14_flavor: Wear it. Wield it. This is the Death Mask Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_1_flavor: This fully automatic assault rifle from Tempus Armament, with the longest barrel available, deals heavy damage to the furthest reaches of the warzone. Stippled grip tape helps control the additional weight, and frangible 7.62mm ammunition compromises targets who take non-lethal hits.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_2_bullet_3: Billet Receiver With Lightweight Milling Cuts
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_2_flavor: Fully automatic assault rifle from Tempus Armament outfitted with a 20.0" long barrel, dealing heavy damage to the furthest reaches of the battlefield.  Stippled grip tape helps control the additional weight, and frangible 7.62mm ammunition compromises targets that take a non-lethal hit.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_4_flavor: The red highlights on the otherwise white Snow Owl assault rifle won't help with camouflage, but will definitely win in style points, along with its fully functional Sniper Scope, FORGE TAC 20" LB, XRK Obelisk Pro stock, and the Recon Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_5_flavor: Featuring an integral Hybrid scope, Muzzle Brake, FTAC Hunter stock, 25-Round Mags, and the Frangible – Disabling Perk.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_6_flavor: Leave plenty of indelible stains with the Sludge Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_7_flavor: Draw back the Red Curtain and you will reveal a fully loaded Assault Rifle with an APX5 Holographic Sight, Muzzle Brake, Forge Tac 20" LB, 12-Gauge Deputy, and 30 Round Mags.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_8_flavor: Give no sympathy and expect none with the black-clad Widower Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_scharlie_9_flavor: Eat away at your enemy's convictions with the Acid Bath Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_sierra552_0_flavor: This modular 5.56 weapon platform is lightweight and maneuverable, with exceptional range. Precision engineering and world-class aftermarket barrels give this weapon extreme potential.
weapon_flavor/ar_sierra552_2_flavor: Fill the mortal realm with the souls of the departed using the Shadowsight Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_sierra552_3_flavor: Feel free to mix business and pleasure with the Downtown Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_0_flavor: A fully automatic bullpup 5.56mm assault rifle from XRK designed to dominate close quarters engagements.  Features an optional custom Cronen precision optic and good selection of barrels. The RAM-7 is the ideal rifle for aggressive and determined operators.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_1_flavor: A fully automatic bullpup 5.56mm assault rifle from XRK designed to dominate close quarters engagements.  Features an optional custom Cronen precision optic and good selection of barrels. The RAM-7 is the ideal rifle for aggressive and determined operators.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_2_flavor: There's no escaping the Sandstorm Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_3_flavor: Sneak behind enemy lines with the Subterfuge Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_4_flavor: This custom RAM-7 from ZLR is a rifle like no other, at the intersection of outstanding aesthetics and peak performance. Acquire your target with an XRK Close Quarters Stock, Precision Holo Sight, and 5mW Tac Laser. Strike fast and hard, again and again, raining down destruction on your enemy.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_5_bullet_2: FORGE TAC Eclipse Polygonal Rifled Barrel
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_5_bullet_6: First Entry in ZLR's Elemental Collection
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_5_flavor: They'll freeze in place like a deer in the headlights when they see the Neurotoxin Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_6_flavor: It's game-over for the enemy with the Glitchy Trigger Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/ar_tango21_7_flavor: Grant deathwishes with the Snap Dragon Assault Rifle.
weapon_flavor/lm_kilo121_1_flavor: Unleash mo' damage with the Mighty Moe LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_kilo121_2_flavor: This bad boy is designed to pack a hefty wallop – the Hazard LMG comes equipped with a Ranger Foregrip, a 150 Round Belt, a 1mW Laser, and No Stock. Luckily, the hazardous conditions it creates are all down-range of the barrel.
weapon_flavor/lm_kilo121_5_flavor: When the sun goes down, it's time to shine with the Dusk LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_kilo121_6_flavor: You'll be a legend when you use the Chupacabra LMG. Goat Blood not included.
weapon_flavor/lm_kilo121_8_flavor: When it looks like cooler heads may prevail, bring the Condenser LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_kilo121_9_flavor: Protect your buds with the Foxglove LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_10_flavor: They'll all be on your wavelength when you pull out the Prism LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_1_flavor: When it comes to having a cunning plan, the Stratagem is first and last port of call. With its Muzzle Flash Guard, SA87 12.4" Factory Barrel, 50 Round Mags, SA87 Ultralight Hollow Stock, and Sleight of Hand Perk, it'll checkmate your opponent every time.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_2_flavor: Since the Ironed Out LMG features a compensator, an SA87 25.4” Factory barrel, a bipod and 50-round mags, it’s sure to smooth out any wrinkles you may encounter on the field of war.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_3_flavor: Unleash The Kraken LMG on your foes for suitably monstrous results: featuring a Scout Combat Optic, SA87 Ultralight Hollow stock, 60-Round Mags, and the Sleight of Hand Perk, the experience of facing off against this weapon is one they would soon rather forget.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_4_flavor: No door or fortification can stand up to the withering firepower of the Buzzsaw. Throw in an Aim-Op Reflex Sight, an SA87 12.4” Factory barrel, Muzzle Brake, and the Ranger Foregrip, and you have the ultimate skeleton key.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_5_flavor: This LMG features canted hybrid optics, an SA87 12.4" factory barrel, a tactical foregrip and a 5mW laser. It will cut stone, but very slowly and the precision leaves a lot to be desired.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_6_flavor: Nietzsche famously said "if thou gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will also gaze into thee," and it's doubly true for this LMG: Solozero NVG Enhanced optic, Monolithic Suppressor, Ranger Foregrip, Forge TAC CQB Comb, Tactical Laser.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_7_flavor: Poison their spirits with the Toxicity LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_8_flavor: If you consort with the enemy, you'll need protection. Here, take the Wolf-Charmer LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_lima86_9_flavor: You'll be stockpiling kills in no time with the Survivalist LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_1_flavor: Return fire with the BLOWtorch LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_2_flavor: The Buster LMG is an equal opportunity buster. It really doesn't care what you point it at, as long as it gets to revel in an orgy of destruction, helped along with its VLK 3.0x Optic, Granulated Grip Tape, and FSS Close Quarters Stock.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_3_flavor: If your aim is to put a dampener on someone’s day, it might as well be with the Buzzkill LMG—the ultimate ‘downer’ with its Corp Combat Holo Sight, FSS Stubby Barrel, FORGE TAC Stalker stock and Fully Loaded Perk.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_5_flavor: When you handle snakes, you need something sturdy to hold onto - in the case of the Snake Beckons LMG, it's a foregrip. Add to that a 75-round belt and the Frangible - Wounding Perk, and you can have at 'em, charmer.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_6_flavor: A winterized LMG balanced for all engagements, the Rockwall is fitted out with a Monocle Reflex sight, FSS Elite barrel, 75 Round Belt, Granulated Grip Tape, and a Forge Tac Stalker.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_7_flavor: You want a hipfire LMG or at least a very fast ADS? Get GRounded! Featuring an FSS stubby, Merc foregrip, stippled grip tape, no stock, and a 5mW laser.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_8_flavor: Take a serious bite out of them with the Copper Spray LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf34_9_flavor: Shiver some timbers with the Plankwalker LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf36_0_flavor: This versatile, fully automatic 5.56mm LMG developed by FORGE TAC is ideal for the gunsmith enthusiast. The Holger’s modular design is configurable for a broad range of engagements, making this weapon viable for any operation that comes your way.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf36_1_flavor: Let rot set in when you wield the Necrosis LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf36_2_flavor: Watch your enemies dry up when you apply the deep, penetrating heat of the Xerocole LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf36_3_flavor: Fight untethered with the Chainbreaker LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf36_4_flavor: This beauty features an 18.9” stainless steel polygonal rifled barrel that pushes the range to maximum operational limits. Its technological features are topped off with ornate golden highlights, meaning this eye-catching rifle will leave your enemies weeping with envy.
weapon_flavor/lm_mgolf36_5_flavor: Crush their spirits and dash their hopes with the Dream Maker LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_10_flavor: Break some bones with the Bludgeoner LMG - and ^1Dismember^7 them while you're at it!
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_14_flavor: Wash their mouths out with more than soap with the Vulgar LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_2_flavor: Return to the Old Country. If your goal is to take down as many tangos as possible in one fell swoop, this LMG is the tool for you. Featuring the APX5 Holographic Sight, Merc Foregrip, 150 Round Belt, and a FORGE TAC Ultralight stock.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_3_flavor: This beefy LMG from Ivanov Group was designed to crown you king of the hill. A muzzle brake, 25.9" heavy barrel, operator foregrip and Frangible - Disabling Perk make this stacked gun one bad MF.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_4_flavor: This custom LMG from STOVL TACTICAL comes equipped with a high-end 3.0x optic, extended belts, and a maneuverable compact barrel. A balance of range, firepower, and agility; one look at this weapon and your enemies will know they picked the wrong lane.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_5_flavor: Feel free to take the #1 spot with the Usurper LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_6_flavor: Take to the streets with The Uprising LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_7_flavor:
Instructions for use: Point at enemy. Turn on. No more enemy. Simple.
A Solozero Optics mini reflex, a monolithic suppressor, a 25.9" heavy barrel, stippled grip tape, and no stock round out this powerful LMG.
weapon_flavor/lm_pkilo_9_flavor: Those aren't smoke signals. It's your Forester LMG.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_10_flavor: Become the baron of any battlefield with the Tycoon Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_11_flavor: Have a pint. Then roll with the pint-sized Top o' the Mornin' Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_12_flavor: Show them you're no antique with the Keepsake Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_13_flavor: Be the agent of decay with the Black Fang Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_15_flavor: A gun you'll always want by your side—the Good Company Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_1_flavor: Silverfield Ordnance manufacture the .357 Barrel on the Enforcer pistol. It’s matched to Snake Shot shotgun pellets and the Mo' Money Perk for good measure.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_3_flavor: The High Noon pistol is a straightforward shooting iron, although it comes with an unbeatable reload time in the form of the Snake Shot, Stippled Grip Tape, and a Sleight of Hand Perk.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_4_flavor: The Callahan hand cannon features a Lockwood Pistol Scope, a .357 Long barrel, Rubberized Grip Tape, and comes with the Recon Perk.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_6_flavor: Paradoxically, the Volatile pistol is just the thing to put an end to any lingering sense of volatility, permanently. Its Aim-Op Reflex Sight, Muzzle Brake, .357 Long barrel, FSS Raider Stock, and Match Grade Trigger will help bring a sense of lasting calm wherever they are applied.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_7_flavor: Featuring a Solozero Optics Mini Reflex, Flash Guard, Silverfield Ordnance .357 barrel, Lockwood .357 Custom Stock, and 1mW Laser, this heavily augmented pistol will punch a hole whether you want it to or not.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_8_flavor: Turns out the Winged Steel referred to in the name of this pistol is the ordnance - all helped along by a .357 snub nose barrel, snake shot, stippled grip tape, 5mW laser, and a lightweight trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_cpapa_9_flavor: The Steeled Nerve pistol will offer stalwart support through thick and thin, and to that end sports a 5mW Laser, Snake Shot, and a Lightweight Trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_10_flavor: Cleave. Rend. Hew. The Asunder Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_11_flavor: The Wiretap Pistol – for those possessed of superior intelligence.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_12_flavor: Leave them to writhe in agony or finish them off with the Gangrene Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_14_flavor: Turn lead into victory with The Alchemist's Dream Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_15_flavor: Small, but full of deadly venom. This is the Cerastes Psitol.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_1_flavor: FORGE TAC .50 cal. hand cannon in plain black with a cold steel slide and heavy sanded matte finish. Rubberized grip tape will help kit out this bare-bones version of FORGE TAC’s most powerful handgun.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_2_flavor: FORGE TAC .50 cal hand cannon in plain black with a cold steel slide and heavy sanded matte finish.  Additional XP per kill will help kit out this bare-bones model of FORGE TAC's most powerful handgun available.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_3_flavor: This pistol, the Royal Decree, will in fact allow you to lay down the law in any manner you see fit. Rubberized grip tape, a match-grade trigger and the Mo' Money Perk mean your orders, however capricious, will never be countermanded. Let them eat lead!
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_4_flavor: Rubberized Grip Tape, a Compensator, and a Cronen C480 Pro Optic mean the Endbringer pistol can really get on with its eponymous job with wild abandon.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_5_flavor: Flirt with greatness with the Pixie Cutter Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_decho_8_flavor: Pack some serious heat with the Hot Nugget Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_10_flavor: Spring into action with the Cherry Blossom Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_11_flavor: The Gemcutter Pistol is a veritable diamond in the rough.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_12_flavor: Send them to a watery grave with the Blue Carbon Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_13_flavor: Keep your spirits high with the Draugr Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_15_flavor: Kill them with Peace and Tranquility (it's a Pistol).
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_16_flavor: Conjure victory from the jaws and intestines of defeat with the Necromancer Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_2_flavor: Custom .45 caliber handgun with a polygonal rifled barrel, custom machined slide, and constructed with lightweight durable polymer. The custom barrel extends effective range on this sidearm and bonus XP earned per kill will make any task pleasurable.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_4_flavor: No need for a constellation of attachments here; the tactical laser, Singuard Arms Featherweight barrel, and Sleight of Hand Perk on this beautiful lavender and sky blue pistol, Pegasus, will help you in your mission to shoot for the stars.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_6_flavor: The Chisel pistol features Solozero Optics' Mini Reflex, a Muzzle Brake, 26-Round Mags, an X16 Stock, and a Lightweight Trigger, meaning it will certainly open a lot of doors for you.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_7_flavor: When speed is of the essence, you will find the inherent stopping power of the Quick Hit pistol to be quite intoxicating. This fast pistol is aided and abetted by the addictive power of the Cronen LP945 Mini Reflex sight, its Monolithic Suppressor, 17 Round Mags, Tac Laser, and a Heavy-Duty Trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_8_flavor: Your faith in the Greenback Pistol is right on the money.
weapon_flavor/pi_golf21_9_flavor: Strike before they can react with the Charmer Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_10_flavor: Become the judge and the jury with The Executioner Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_11_flavor: Eradicate hairy pests with the Bear Trap Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_12_flavor: Any amount of exposure to the Isotoper Pistol will likely prove lethal.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_13_flavor: Up down left right FIRE with the Button Masher Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_14_flavor: Make it hard on them with the Carbide Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_15_flavor: Break away from the herd with the Elk Rut Pistol and add some carnage to your loadout with the included ^1Dismemberment^7 effect.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_16_flavor: Become an honorary member of Taskforce 141 when you rock the One for One Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_2_flavor: Blindside your enemies with this tailor-made sidearm recovered and rebuilt from the wreckage of Barkov’s Gas Factory. A removable flash guard helps conceal your position and a polygonal rifled barrel increases your muzzle velocity as well as the effective range of this .45 pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_3_flavor: When you find yourself in a foreign land with intent to claim it, you need The Invader, a pistol with aspirations above its station, featuring a Muzzle Brake, 15 Round Mags, and the maximum reserve ammo afforded by the Fully Loaded Perk.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_5_flavor: The Obsidian Carat is a superlative sidearm, featuring everything the serious sportsman would want: a .45 Match Grade barrel, Muzzle Brake, 10 Round Mags, a hefty 1mW Laser, and a Lightweight Trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_6_flavor: The Bite Strength pistol will take a chunk out of anyone’s plans for a carefree day. A G.I. Mini Reflex sight, Muzzle Brake, Match Grade Trigger, and a Fast Melee Perk all help clamp down on the enemy and bring the pain.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_7_flavor: When the smell of sulfur is in the air, look for the Sulfuric pistol with a Compensator, .45 Match Grade barrel, Rubberized Grip Tape, Tac Laser, and a Lightweight Trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_8_flavor: The Blue Dwarf is a well-rounded and flashy pistol with blue tracer fire. Featuring a Cronen LP945 Mini Reflex, 1911 Stalker Barrel, 15 Round mags, 5mW Laser, and a Lightweight Trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike1911_9_flavor: Go twelve rounds with the Fisticuffs Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike9_0_flavor: Well rounded semi-auto 9mm pistol.  This unassuming sidearm excels in close range combat, and features gunsmithing capabilities unique to the pistol class that permit a variety of engagement strategies.
weapon_flavor/pi_mike9_1_flavor: When everything else goes south, the Guard One Pistol keeps on dropping tangos, like it’s going out of style.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_10_flavor: Send them to the gulag with the Privet Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_11_flavor: The Utilitarian Pistol is perfect for everyday carry as well as everyday mayhem.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_14_flavor: Put a cavity in 'em with the Mint Chip Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_1_flavor: If you are looking for speed, efficiency and resiliency in a pistol, the Slick Steel, equipped with Solozero Optics Mini Reflex, Tac Laser, and the Frangible - Wounding Perk, fits the bill admirably.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_2_flavor: Someone’s got to do it, and if that someone is you, you’ll be glad you had the Dirty Business pistol with its Lightweight Trigger, 21 Round Mags, and Frangible - Wounding Perk.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_3_flavor: If gambling is your idea of a good time, the High Roller pistol, with its Monolithic Suppressor, 5mW Laser, G.I. Mini Reflex optic, Lightweight Trigger, and Frangible – Disabling Perk, is for you.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_4_flavor: The Severance pistol—with its 21 Round Mags, Rubberized Grip Tape, and Mo' Money Perk—will help cut ties between you and those at the bottom of the scoreboard.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_5_flavor: Add ventilation holes to your opponents in all the wrong places with the Aspirator pistol, featuring a Cronen LP945 mini reflex sight, XRK V extended barrel, 32-round mags, Match Grade Trigger, and the Sleight of Hand Perk.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_6_flavor: It's not black and white. It's the Two-Tone Pistol.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_7_flavor: A Muzzle Brake, XRK L Super barrel, Granulated Grip Tape, and Heavy-Duty Trigger all mean it’s lights out for your enemies when you bring the White Out pistol to bear.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_8_flavor: You, too, can be a small, cool star with the Red Dwarf pistol which packs a big punch with its Cronen LP945 Mini Reflex sight, XRK L Super, 32 Round Mags, 5mW laser, and a Lightweight Trigger.
weapon_flavor/pi_papa320_9_flavor: Hit 'em right where it hurts with the Moneymaker Pistol.
weapon_flavor/romeo870_17_flavor: Gorge yourself on vermin with the Puff Adder Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_11_flavor: Take out all the FNGs with the Green Horn Shotgun. You'll be doing them a favor.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_12_flavor: More dangerous than an icepick. The Ice Storm Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_2_flavor: With Stumpy, you’re getting a rough and ready over-under shotgun with a G.I. Mini Reflex Sight, Sawed-off Barrel and Stock, and the extremely useful Sleight of Hand Perk which will keep you in the game as you dish out the mayhem.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_3_flavor: Possibly once used for grouse shooting in Scotland, the Outback over-under shotgun has now been converted to combat use with the judicious addition of a Brownlee 32mm Scope, Tempus Smooth Bore barrel, Tempus Sport stock, and the Recon Perk.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_4_flavor: The Rail Splitter is the sort of over-under shotgun you could use to hammer nails all day and still have it cut dead center on target every time. It features a choke, a smooth bore manufactured by Tempus, an FTAC equilibrium stock and the Mo' Money Perk.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_6_flavor: The Dread shotgun inspires its namesake stomach-churning fear in all who encounter it—it's a midrange killing machine comprised of a Cronen C480 Pro Optic, Tempus 32" Competition barrel, Ranger Foregrip, Slug Rounds, and a Forge Tac Commander.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_7_flavor: The Ruin Seeker shotgun is built for long range engagements but ironically uses a sawed-off stock to allow for fast ADS - in real life it would likely break your wrist. Featuring a Monolithic Suppressor, Tempus 32" Competition Barrel, Sawed-off Stock, 1mW Laser, and a Tempus SlimGrip.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_8_flavor: Who cares about their feelings? You have the Ivory Tower Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_charlie725_9_flavor: Land the knockout punch with the CQBoom Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_dpapa12_10_flavor: Deal the finishing blow with the Skull Hammer Shotgun, and ^1Dismember^7 them for good measure!
weapon_flavor/sh_dpapa12_4_flavor: Despite appearances to the contrary, the Choke, Tac Laser, FTAC Close Quarters Pro pump slide, and a Heavy Hitter Perk mean the Hardhat shotgun will outperform similar weapons from the word go.
weapon_flavor/sh_dpapa12_5_flavor: Narrow down their choices with the Restrictor Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_dpapa12_6_flavor: The Sound of Death's Voice is created using a double-barreled shotgun fitted out with a Cronen C480 Pro Optic, Choke, Forge Tac Sentry, Merc Foregrip, and Slug Rounds.
weapon_flavor/sh_dpapa12_7_flavor: Release the dogs of war with the Bloodhound Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_dpapa12_8_flavor: Live your best mercenary life with the Doubloon Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_mike26_1_flavor: Wipeout your enemies with the Pipeline Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_mike26_2_flavor: Start an epidemic with the First Horseman Shotgun
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_10_flavor: You'll be a soldier of significant fortune with the Bankroll Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_1_flavor: Covert, yet still overt. This is the Stealth Action Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_2_flavor: Redemption is within your reach with the Final Reprieve semi-automatic shotgun, whose 12-round mags, lack of stock, and Fully Loaded Perk will give you every opportunity to enact last-ditch retribution on your foes.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_3_flavor: Clean up nice with the Pastel Death Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_5_flavor: Turn them into public enemies with the Demon Eyes Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_6_flavor: This semi-automatic 12-gauge shotgun from FORGE TAC has been carefully engineered to get the most out of this unique weapon platform. All attachments have been curated to help keep you stable and on target before engaging your prey.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_7_flavor: The Slizen semi-automatic shotgun is a real beast that dishes out the pain with its APX5 Holographic Sight, FORGE TAC Impaler barrel, 8 Round Slug Mags, and a Granulated Grip Tape.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_8_flavor: Dark matter may or may not exist, but your enemies will definitely cease to exist when you equip the Dark Matter Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_oscar12_9_flavor: Chase down your enemies with the Sleeping Dragon Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_10_flavor: They'll be bound to erect a statue of you and your Imperatorium Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_11_flavor: Finish in first with the Outrunner Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_12_flavor: A weapon to help you survive the world's hotspots: the Firedrake Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_14_flavor: Ice the competition with the Permafrost Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_17_flavor: Gorge yourself on the vermin with the Puff Adder Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_1_flavor: Tempus Armament's premium 12-gauge pump-action shotgun features a low-profile reflex sight and an ultralight polymer stock that lets you out-maneuver your enemies while staying on target. This exceptional weapon reloads significantly faster than comparable models.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_2_flavor: The Muck and Mire Shotgun will be with you through thick and thin.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_5_flavor: Jaw-dropping and body popping. Enjoy the Showstopper Shotgun in all its gory glory.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_7_flavor: The Black Betty shotgun not only talks a good game, but delivers everywhere it counts. Check out the Corp Combat holo sight, XRK 18.0" Liberator barrel, XRK Truegrip tactical pump slide, FTAC Stalker-12 stock and 5mW laser
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_8_flavor: If you're looking for a team member who pulls their weight on the regular, you could definitely do worse than the Corner Clear shotgun, which features a Choke, an XRK 30" Sport Barrel, a Lockwood Precision Series underbarrel, and a Lockwood Precision Stock.
weapon_flavor/sh_romeo870_9_flavor: Be more divisive with the Gulf Stalker Shotgun.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_10_flavor: Look down on your opponents through the sights of the Affluenza SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_11_flavor: Live to fight another day with the Antivenom SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_2_flavor: Your opponents will likely not hear too many whizzbys from the Airshot SMG, whose Muzzle Brake, 407mm Lightweight barrel, Commando Foregrip, and 5.56 NATO 30-Round Mags Combine to make accuracy and handling things of legitimate beauty.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_3_flavor: Barely street-legal. This is the High Octane SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_4_flavor: Despite appearances, the Trust Fund SMG has not had an easy life. It is a self-made gun that has worked hard for its money and attachments. Including: The Integral Hybrid scope, Muzzle Brake, Commando Foregrip, the FSS Heavy Stock Pro, and Mo' Money Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_5_flavor: Maritime's always the right time with the Night Raid SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_6_flavor: Although the Dame Fortuna SMG favors the bold, she will be less forgiving of the opposition. This is mostly due to being decked out with the latest tech in terms of her tactical foregrip, 5.56 NATO 30-round mags, FORGE TAC CQB comb, and Frangible - Disabling.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_7_flavor: The Breach Beast SMG is the proverbial unstoppable force when it comes to slinging lead in a tactical situation. An Integral 3.0x Optic, Muzzle Brake, 622mm Long Barrel, Tactical Foregrip, and 5.56 NATO 30 Round Mags complete the picture.
weapon_flavor/sm_augolf_9_flavor: Drain your opponents' will to live with the Leecher SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_10_flavor: The Snowblower SMG is guaranteed  to leave them bitter and twisted.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_11_flavor: Tear up the enemy with the Ravager SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_1_flavor: Whether or not history records you to be on the side of right or wrong, the Moral Argument SMG will be all you need to prove your point in the moment. 84 Round Helical mags, a Corvus Skeleton Stock, Tac Laser, and Mo' Money Perk will put an end to any debate.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_2_flavor: If you can get past the garish paintjob, the Zebra SMG is actually very well equipped to earn its stripes on the battlefield - all helped along by its Solozero NVG Enhanced optic, Tactical Suppressor, and Factory Aluminum Stock.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_3_flavor: An APX5 Holographic Sight, Compensator, and Granulated Grip Tape mean the Last Warrior SMG is the last gun you will ever need to rely on in a tight pinch. It’s the type of gun that would stay behind and defend your retreat with a few remaining bullets and a single grenade.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_4_flavor: Nursing Death is a high-capacity SMG and includes a Viper Reflex Sight, Monolithic Suppressor, 84 Round Helical Mags, and a Frangible - Wounding Perk. A seemingly endless supply of ammo will be the least of your quarry’s problems however.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_5_flavor: Make it rain enemy tears with the Purple Rain SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_7_flavor: The Wolf's Bite SMG features an integral hybrid optic, compensator, 8.7" aluminum barrel, rubberized grip tape, FSS close quarters stock and long, sharp, canine teeth.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_8_flavor: This SMG features a Cronen C480 Pro Optic, a Granulated Grip Tape, Compensator, a Corvus Skeleton Stock, a Heavy Hitter Perk, and absolutely refuses to give up.
weapon_flavor/sm_beta_9_flavor: Adapt to survive the battle with the Chuckwalla SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_11_flavor: Fire when ready with the Blue Blaze SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_12_flavor: Become the gold standard with the Ducat SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_1_flavor: The Strapped is an SMG equipped with an FSS Light, an FTAC Collapsible stock, and a Ranger Foregrip. It also comes with the Sleight of Hand Perk which will diminish unnecessary down time, leaving you free to get on with the bloody business at hand.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_2_flavor: The Admiral’s Pride is a nautical flavored SMG which allows you to navigate the treacherous waters of any engagement with ease, and features an Aim-Op reflex sight, an FSS light, 45-round mags, a classic straight-line stock and the Frangible - Wounding Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_4_flavor: The fully loaded SMG from FDE is the perfect balance of control, range, agility and firepower. Precision and powerful accessories ensure that every bullet counts when targeting your own snakes in the grass.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_5_flavor: Mop the floor with your enemies using the Flood SMG which features an FSS Mini, Operator Foregrip, 45 Round Mags, FORGE TAC Ultralight, and the Sleight of Hand Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_6_flavor: Report only to the very highest authority with the Cover Up SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_8_flavor: While it doesn't actually aim itself, the Point Blank also doesn't require much work to get great results either, thanks in large part to its bevy of attachments: the FSS Mini barrel, FORGE TAC Ultralight stock, 45-Round Mags, and the Fast Melee Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa5_9_flavor: Go off the deep end once too often with the Rampage SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa7_10_flavor: Make them worship you with the Reverence SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa7_2_flavor: All death is inevitable. But especially when you roll with the Sands of Time SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa7_7_flavor: Bring some refinement to the dirty business at hand with the Vespertine SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa7_8_flavor: Burning bright with vengeance? Take on enemies of all stripes with the Bengal SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_mpapa7_9_flavor: Keep the pests at bay with the Bug Spray SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_10_flavor: Leave behind heaps of enemies when you bring the Mowed Down SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_11_flavor: You can be a lover AND a fighter—pump them full of lead with the Casanova SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_12_flavor: Execute all the executive protection protocols with the Neutralizer SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_15_flavor: Take their breath away—permanently—with the Smoke Show SMG
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_1_flavor: This custom-designed bullpup SMG from First Signal Solutions spits high velocity 5.7x28mm rounds at a hefty 950 RPM. Featuring a high tensile polymer body and black nitride receiver, this bare-bones edition is ready for gunsmithing.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_2_bullet_1: High tensile polymer body / Black nitride receiver
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_3_flavor: While the Area 51 SMG isn’t actual alien technology, you’d be forgiven for thinking otherwise with its advanced Corp Combat Holo Sight, Compensator, Stippled Grip Tape, Tac Laser, and Frangible - Wounding Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_4_flavor: To become an adept arctic hunter, the Blizzard Warfare SMG spent its formative years acclimating to the cold in the family chest freezer. The training has paid off and it is now adorned with a G.I. Mini Reflex sight, a Flash Guard, Granulated Grip Tape, FSS Heavy Stock Pro, and the Fully Loaded Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_5_flavor: Steamroll your enemies with the X-PaNZer SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_7_flavor: With this SMG, you can choose to slink in the shadows or come out in the bright light of day - the choice will be yours since it's equipped for every eventuality: Canted Hybrid Optic, Muzzle Compensator, FORGE TAC Retribution barrel extension, a FSS Heavy Stock Pro, and an FMJ Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_8_flavor: This SMG was born of sin - the equipped FSS ring sight, muzzle brake, 5mW laser, granulated grip tape, and a fly strap mean there is no redemption on the horizon either.
weapon_flavor/sm_papa90_9_flavor: Watch your enemies melt when you bring this sublime SMG to bear: Aim-OP reflex sight, muzzle brake, stippled and rubberized grip tape, and an FSS heavy pro stock.
weapon_flavor/sm_smgolf45_0_flavor: A hard-hitting submachine gun chambered in .45 Auto that will shred at longer distances than other weapons in its class. A moderate rate of fire helps keep the gun under control while in fully automatic mode.
weapon_flavor/sm_smgolf45_1_flavor: Death is your business and business is good with the Undertaker SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_smgolf45_2_flavor: Sit them down with the Turbulence SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_smgolf45_3_flavor: The day has come for you enemies with The Reckoning SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_10_flavor: Brute force their reaction times with the Mach 5 SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_12_flavor: Watch their plans come off the rails with the Freight Train SMG, featuring the .41 AE conversion kit—for harder-hitting, long-range ammunition—as well as the FSS Carbine Pro barrel, an advanced polygonal rifled barrel which pushes damage and muzzle velocity to the max.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_13_flavor: Show them what kind of heat you're packing with the Pocketed Malice SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_1_flavor: Corvus Defense has taken this already maneuverable SMG and added an 8.5” mini barrel for exceptionally fast handling. Combined with a lightweight reflex from Solozero and a position-concealing flash guard, this agile weapon helps you own close-quarters.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_2_flavor: Corvus Defense has taken this already maneuverable submachine gun and added a 8.5" mini barrel for exceptionally fast weapon handling. Combined with a lightweight reflex from Solozero and a position-concealing flash guard, this agile weapon helps you dominate close quarters. Designed for faster reloads to keep the lead flying.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_3_flavor: In some ways, the Infiltrator SMG can be seen as the ultimate credit card: it has been outfitted with the Integral Hybrid optic, 16.5” Factory Carbine barrel, Lightweight Suppressor, FSS Close Quarters Stock, and Merc Foregrip, to ease access to even the most exclusive and well-defended venues.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_5_flavor: Shake them to their very core with the Meltdown SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_6_flavor: Try a speed run using the Speed Run SMG and you'll make good use of the Merc Foregrip, 50 Round Mags, No Stock, 5mW Laser, and a Fully Loaded Perk.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_7_flavor: When you're cornered and need to whip it out, consider the Quick Snap — Canted Hybrid optics, a Compensator, a Commando Foregrip, 50 Round Mags, and a Tactical Laser will quickly earn you the designation Stranger Danger.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_8_flavor: Remember, it's muzzle towards enemy with the Golden Rule SMG.
weapon_flavor/sm_uzulu_9_flavor: Put a shine on your lead with the All That Glitters SMG.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_10_flavor: Become a snake in the grass with the Boomslang Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_1_flavor: This weapon is great at drumming up new business for undertakers. The Corpse Maker is a sniper rifle featuring Singuard Arms Pro barrel, Stippled Grip Tape, Singuard Arms Assassin stock, and the Recon Perk.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_3_flavor: If it really comes down to your Last Chance, this sniper rifle will be exactly what you need. The Flash Guard, Bipod, Granulated Grip Tape, and Frangible - Wounding Perk are just what the doctor ordered to help get you out of potentially sticky situations before they turn deadly.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_4_flavor: In any great battle, a fabled weapon will come into its own. So it is with the Ragnarok sniper rifle, whose 17" Factory Barrel, Granulated Grip Tape, and Singuard Arms Evader stock allow it to aid in the swift dispatch of legions of the inglorious, inept, unskilled, and unworthy.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_5_flavor: Anyone who learns about your exploits at the wrong end of the Trebuchet's sniper barrel will be bowled over by the devastating firepower provided by the Scout Combat optic, 17" factory barrel, Granulated grip tape, Focus perk, and Singuard Arms assassin.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_6_flavor: If you need to take down a bunch of animals in a hurry, look no further than the Big Game sniper rifle with its Variable Zoom scope, 32" Factory Barrel, Bipod, Granulated Grip Tape, and a Singuard Arms Marksman stock.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_7_flavor: Watch them go berserk looking for your Witching Hour Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_8_flavor: Bury your enemies deep with the Fuelrod Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_alpha50_9_flavor: Expunge any dark spots from your record with the Sunspot Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_crossbow_2_flavor: Don't let them out of your sights with the Watchful Eye Crossbow.
weapon_flavor/sn_crossbow_4_flavor: This wintry take on the classic crossbow has many unconventional aspects to it, not least of which are the Aim-Op Reflex sight, the FTAC Backburn 20" bolts, FSS SpeedTrak stock, XRK Thunder 200 Lb arms, and the Sleight of Hand Perk.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_2_flavor: See the enemy in a whole new light. This is the Chroma Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_3_flavor: What would the weapon of a Semi-God be like? Apparently, it has a Variable Zoom Scope, 15 Round Mags, a Skeleton Stock, and features the Recon Perk. So now you know.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_4_flavor: This gas-operated semi-automatic sniper rifle offers cutting-edge technology for stalking prey. In addition to the bipod for stability, the VLK lightweight stock for mobility and a dual-power scope with thermal view, additional XP is earned for every kill you bag.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_5_flavor: The Crimson Ursa sniper rifle will get the claret flowing in no time. But unlike its namesake, this weapon is definitely no bear to operate - a Lightweight Suppressor, Cronen C480 Pro Optic, and the Sleight of Hand Perk see to that.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_6_flavor: Run Rampant with the Tusk Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_7_flavor: Launch every hostile takeover with the Sell High Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_8_flavor: The Stone Cold Sniper Rifle knows it's a killer, but what about you?
weapon_flavor/sn_delta_9_flavor: Keep your cool with the Meltdown Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_1_flavor: Hadir’s pet project variant of this anti-materiel 12.7x108mm bolt-action sniper rifle comes equipped with a high-power variable zoom scope capable of 12.6x magnification. HRH comes equipped with a high-end competition stock from FTAC that maintains exceptional stability at maximum magnification.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_2_flavor: Hadir's pet project variant of this anti-material 12.7 x 108mm bolt action sniper rifle comes equipped with a high power variable zoom scope capable of 12.6x magnification. Equipped with a high end competition stock from FTAC that maintains exceptional stability at maximum magnification. Additional XP with each kill will help you kit out this remarkable weapon in no time.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_3_flavor: The Oceanographer Sniper Rifle: like shooting fish in a barrel.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_5_flavor: Whatever the Latin word is for 'Pwnage' - the Scorpionem has it in abundance: Scout Combat Optic, Lightweight Suppressor, a FTAC hunter-scout, and a Focus Perk. Sic.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_6_flavor: The Alpha sniper rifle is top dog when it comes to utilizing its Thermal Sniper Scope, Lightweight Suppressor, 26.9" HDR Pro barrel, FSS Nomad stock, and its Presence of Mind Perk. Good luck mastering it!
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_7_flavor: True to its name, the Great White sniper rifle is equipped with a 26.0" Bull Barrel, FTAC Stalker-Scout stock, and a Fast Melee Perk, allowing you to smell the blood in the water from a great distance before wading in for the kill.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_8_flavor: Get a head start on the competition with the Early Riser Sniper Rifle.
weapon_flavor/sn_hdromeo_9_flavor: Take down the apparatus of power with the End State Sniper.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_10_flavor: They won't feel a thing with the Guillotine DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_16_flavor: No Need to be startled, it's just the Open Season DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_3_flavor: Reach out and touch the enemy in new and exciting ways with the Butterfly Kisses marksman rifle, with its 4.0x Flip Hybrid scope, Singuard Custom 21.2" barrel, Hollow Stock Mod, and Sleight of Hand Perk.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_4_flavor: The Dust Devil is the type of marksman rifle you happily make a pact with, what with it's Scout Combat Optic, Muzzle Brake, Singuard Custom 27.6" barrel, STVOL Precision Comb, and all-important Mo' Money Perk.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_5_flavor: Solozero’s modern take on a classic bolt-action sniper rifle proves this combat-tested weapon can still hold its ground while reaching out to enemies on the battlefield.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_6_bullet_3: Rubberized Grip Tape for recoil control
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_6_flavor: When you find yourself in the eye of the storm, look to the Heart of the Beast DMR for guidance. Featuring an Integral Hybrid Optic, Singuard Custom 27.6" barrel, Lightweight Suppressor, and FTAC Sport Comb.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_7_flavor: An excellent future awaits you with the Sterling DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_8_flavor: The Incisor DMR: perfect for your itchy trigger-talon.
weapon_flavor/sn_kilo98_9_flavor: The Black Diamond DMR doesn't have to be the route of last resort.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_10_flavor: Unleash a torrent of carnage with the Rip Current DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_13_flavor: Shed your worries along with your enemies with the Cottonmouth DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_1_flavor: Custom FORGE TAC designated marksman rifle. The FORGE TAC 22” precision barrel and low-profile flash hider will conceal your shots while increasing muzzle velocity and range. Bonus XP per kill will help you kit out this gem in no time.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_2_flavor: FORGE TAC has taken this 7.62mm marksman rifle and enhanced it to create a long range, highly maneuverable killing machine with teeth. Precision optics hit 7.0x magnification, and an authentic FSS Raider Chassis Elite lower and stock give superior agility while engaging targets.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_3_flavor: FORGE TAC has taken this 7.62mm marksman rifle and enhanced it, creating a long range, highly maneuverable killing machine.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_4_flavor: The type of messages sent by this marksman rifle — The Messenger — vary quite considerably. There’s “don’t mess with me” and “I’m the best” and, well, actually that’s it. A Variable Zoom Scope, Monolithic Suppressor, 15-Round Mag capacity, and the Frangible - Disabling Perk mean you will never be lost for words.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_5_flavor: The Flesh Wound marksman rifle’s Sniper Scope, Tactical Suppressor, and FORGE TAC Precision 22" barrel allow you to hit, hit, hit and run all day.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_6_flavor: The Eradication marksman rifle does one thing well - it eradicates. This is testament in no small part to the Operator Reflex Sight, FORGE TAC Elite barrel, Operator Foregrip, FSS Raider Chassis Pro stock and Focus Perk it comes equipped with.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_7_flavor: The ZLR Special DMR is a MNSTR: 4.0x Flip Hybrid Optic, Muzzle Brake, Forge Tac Elite barrel (this is a shorter barrel for faster ADS speed), Ranger Foregrip, and FTAC Lightweight Stock.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_8_flavor: Failure to launch will not be an option with the Moonphase DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_mike14_9_flavor: Swift deaths only. That's the Line Breaker DMR way.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_10_flavor: You'll soon be on a tear with the Torn DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_11_flavor: Their luck's run out when they see your Wish Me Luck DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_13_flavor: The perfect balance of strength and flexibility. This is the Bamboo Shoot DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_2_flavor: Be a model soldier with the Heartthrob DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_3_flavor: Game the system and bag some wins with The Warden marksman rifle, equipped with an FSS 24" Factory barrel, a Cartridge Sleeve, and the Frangible - Wounding Perk.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_4_flavor: The path less trodden is taken by the Dusty Trail marksman rifle — the Sniper Scope, FSS 24" Factory barrel, and Mo' Money Perk will let you pick off stragglers, outliers and lone wolves with ease.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_6_flavor: The only color you'll paint with the Brushstroke DMR is red.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_7_flavor: Teach them how they did it back in your day with the Golden Age DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_sbeta_8_flavor: Send them packing with the Walking Stick DMR.
weapon_flavor/sn_sksierra_0_flavor: Lightweight semi-auto Carbine chambered in 7.62x39mm.  This hard hitting and agile Soviet rifle focuses on utility over accuracy.  It flaunts a faster fire rate than other weapons in its class, but a carefully placed round will eliminate the need for follow up shots entirely.  This classic DMR has seen a lot of battles, and its unique gunsmith configurations reflect a diverse service history.
weapon_flavor/sn_sksierra_1_flavor: The Utility Tool DMR is the perfect ‘just in case’ weapon you should always keep about your person.
